_comment: ROUND-6: the over-generic title markers ('blend', 'formula', 'powder', 'extract', 'serving(s)', 'drops', 'herb') routed a cookbook ('Weeknight Blend'), a watercolour set ('Blend and Layer') and a bag of coffee ('Espresso Blend') into a regulated pack that then demanded a compliance disclaimer. 'vitamin'/'collagen'/'biotin' moved to categoryGatedTitleMarkers: they are tried LAST, after cosmetics, so a vitamin C serum routes to cosmetics instead of being asked for a supplement disclaimer.
_categoryGatedTitleMarkersComment: Ingredient words that are equally at home in a regulated product and a cosmetic. They only route here AFTER every cosmetics marker has been tried (see lib/knowledge/detectCategory).
